# Best solar generator with panels included

There's no single best one, because it depends on how much power you need. For most people, a roughly 1 kWh kit is the sweet spot. It can run a fridge for several hours, plus a CPAP, laptops and lights.

## My pick for most people: ALLPOWERS P1800 + 400 W panel kit
- It has a 1,024 Wh LiFePO4 battery, which is rated for thousands of charge cycles, and 1,800 W AC output.
- It includes a 400 W panel, about twice what most 1 kWh kits ship with, so it recharges faster in sun.
- Price is $731, or $657.90 with code ALLPOWERS26.
- [Buy it here](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-p1800-sp037-solar-kit)

Two caveats:
- The comparison guide I'm drawing on (Dealectric) is paid through its buy links. Its figures come from the makers' pages and its own cart tests.
- ALLPOWERS is a lesser-known brand than Jackery or EcoFlow, so consider the warranty and support before buying.

## Well-known-brand alternatives (about 1 kWh)
| Kit | Battery | Panel | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Jackery Solar Generator 1000 v2](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included) | 1,070 Wh LiFePO4, 1,500 W | 200 W | $699 |
| [EcoFlow DELTA 3 Classic + 220 W](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels) | 1,024 Wh LiFePO4, 1,800 W | 220 W bifacial | $699 |
| [BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180-200w-solar-kit) | 1,152 Wh LiFePO4, 1,800 W | 200 W | $769 (code AFF5OFF saves $38.45) |

- **Jackery 1000 v2** has the most buyer reviews (about 1.4K at 4.5 stars) and is Amazon's "Overall Pick".
- **EcoFlow DELTA 3 Classic** is rated 4.6 stars across 404 reviews and is discounted from a $1,099 list price.
- **BLUETTI AC180** is cheaper at Dealectric's $769 than the $899 Amazon listing in the results.

## If you need home backup (about 2 kWh)
- **[BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2-200w-solar-kit):** $1,199 (code AFF5OFF saves $59.95). It has 2,073.6 Wh and accepts up to 1,000 W of panels later. It ships from Oct 29.
- **[Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 + 2×200 W](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included):** $1,399.

## On a tight budget
- **[ALLPOWERS VOLIX P300 + 100 W](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-volix-p300-100w-solar-kit):** $208.99, with 256 Wh. It's fine for phones, lights and a laptop, but not a fridge.

## Tips
- A folding panel delivers roughly 60–75% of its rating in good sun. A 200 W panel adds about 600–750 Wh on a clear day.
- Prefer LiFePO4 batteries for longevity.
- Check the station's maximum solar input before choosing, since it limits how many panels you can add later.
- Bundles aren't always cheaper. The guide flags ALLPOWERS' R4000 kit as costing about $400 more than buying the pieces separately.

If you tell me what you want to power and for how long, I can narrow this to one kit.

Sources: [Dealectric comparison](https://dealectric.com/solar-generator-with-panels-included), [Amazon results](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included), [Amazon results 2](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels)
